translation.canonical_title: The term "woke" has no real meaning
translation.displayed_title: The term "woke" has no real meaning
translation.summary: The realities covered by this term vary enormously according to the political orientation of those using it. Within the left, it thus serves to group activist techniques regarded as morally indefensible, such as harassment, book burning, whether real or symbolic, and performativity; the far right uses it either to make an x-phobic and x-ist ideology more palatable while claiming the opposite—particularly by arbitrarily grouping selected struggles with objectionable methods of action—or to demonize all social struggles. Moreover, there is no consensus on what can or cannot be placed under this label, and legitimate struggles are often lumped together with objectionable methods. Besides, it no longer has the same meaning as when it originated, since its pejorative meaning is relatively recent.
